faqs.question: What technologies do you use to build websites at iWAAT?
faqs.answer: We primarily build modern, high-performance web applications using React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. This modern frontend stack ensures sub-second page loads, fluid micro-interactions, and exceptional maintainability compared to monolithic legacy platforms.

faqs.question: How do you ensure iWAAT websites are optimized for search engines?
faqs.answer: Every website we engineer includes clean semantic HTML5 markup, structured Schema.org JSON-LD data, dynamic canonical URLs, optimized Open Graph cards, fast Core Web Vitals, and mobile-first responsive design right out of the box.

faqs.question: Can iWAAT build e-commerce and custom booking systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. We engineer both e-commerce product storefronts and custom service booking workflows with secure payment gateways, inventory catalogs, and administrative order management.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a website and a custom web application?
faqs.answer: A website is primarily designed for informational, branding, and content delivery purposes. A web application is an interactive software tool that handles complex user authentication, dynamic data manipulation, business workflows, custom dashboards, and database transactions.

faqs.question: How do you ensure data security in custom software?
faqs.answer: We enforce industry-standard security practices including strict Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, encrypted sessions, Content Security Policies (CSP), parameterized database queries, and role-based access controls.

faqs.question: How long does it take to see results from SEO?
faqs.answer: SEO is a medium to long-term organic growth strategy. While technical fixes and indexing optimizations take effect within weeks, significant organic keyword ranking gains typically develop over 3 to 6 months as domain authority and topical depth increase.

faqs.question: Do you set up analytics and conversion tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and custom event tracking so you have transparent visibility into incoming leads, traffic channels, and user engagement.
